Title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials (GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY)
Analysis:
Source: Hard-coded secret API key `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` defined in the source file.
Sanitization/Validation: None. While the API response truncates the key with `substring(0, 8)`, the full secret key is permanently committed and exposed within the codebase.
Sink: The hardcoded assignment `const GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY = "AIzaSyD-mock-key-for-guardrails-demo-4402"`.

Conceptual Exploit Payload:
An attacker reviewing the source code or client/server bundle extracts the hardcoded credential:
`GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY = "AIzaSyD-mock-key-for-guardrails-demo-4402"`
The attacker can then misuse the credential against Google Maps APIs:
`curl "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?address=1600+Amphitheatre+Parkway&key=AIzaSyD-mock-key-for-guardrails-demo-4402"`
